first canny I've actually commented in. I'd love this! I'm so tired of the same tips over and over!! at the very least, make them less front and center pleeease.

Agreed. If they really want to make sure the people who do need to see these aren't disabling them, they can just make it a VRC+ feature or something, since it's required to use the old loading screen anyway.
Oh whoops I made a topic cause this didn't show when I searched. 100% agree!

Maybe we can get a series of options as well?

All, New/Relative, None, Funny.

All - What it currently is.

New/Relative - Only new or relative tips released as part of TOS related updates such as “Don’t share your login info with others.”

None - No tips will be shown. We are free!

Funny - Inside jokes of the community and gaming at large. Such as: 

“Press the Jump button to Jump!”

WARNING! Only works in worlds where Jumping is enabled. 

“Get VRC+ Now!”

(Only shown to those with an active VRC+ subscription. Purchased or Gifted)

“Enter Portals or pick a world from the World menu to visit somewhere else!”

(You’re literally doing this.)

——

The OP’s idea of letting you dismiss a tip that you seen should also be added. 

“Do not show this again"
This would be nice, on top of an option to have one's VRC photos replace the tooltips, and only photos in the default folder; maybe make it a VRC+ thingy.
it's gonna be vrc+ member only for sure xd

details:
With the addition of Loading Screen Customisations, adding a feature to hide Information and Tips during loading would be nice.

This could be done manually on each tip card to "Do not show this again", ensuring new tips will still be shown or as a whole "Do not show Info Boxes" option.

Especially with the new Old Loading Screen, the boxes block the view of the great and vast space of VRChat.

I attached an image of what I mean by Information/Tips boxes.
title: Feature to Hide Loading Screen Information and Tips
